objective: Win one bounded KiCad plugin evaluation by pairing a purpose-built geometry fixture with larger project-owned board evidence, without claiming the buyer's plugin was tested before authorized delivery.

source_need.title: KiCad Plugin Testing & Feedback
source_need.activity_when_submitted: The listing header showed 19 bids; the submitted proposal was then ranked 20 of 20.
source_need.buyer_state: The visible listing showed a Navoiy, Uzbekistan buyer with identity, payment, deposit, email, profile, and phone verification plus two 5.0 reviews.
requested_work: Install the buyer-supplied Rounder for Tracks v3.2 package
Exercise its settings on angled traces
Report bugs, usability issues, and enhancement ideas
scope_unknowns: supported KiCad version and operating system
expected behavior for infeasible corner radii
source_need.policy: Do not download or run an untrusted package until the buyer supplies an authorized source and the funded scope is accepted. Keep contract, files, communication, and payment on Freelancer.

executed_fixture.boundary: Project-owned synthetic fixture only; the buyer's plugin, package, settings, board, and acceptance result have not been tested.

larger_board_evidence.boundary: Project-owned public board evidence, not a customer result or a run of Rounder for Tracks.

not_proven: installation or behavior of Rounder for Tracks v3.2
compatibility with the buyer's KiCad and OS combination

application.milestone_description: KiCad settings sweep, screenshots, DRC comparison, and report
application.policy: Submit at most once with no paid upgrade. Do not begin until the package source, license, supported environment, test-board boundary, acceptance criteria, and funded milestone are agreed.
